name: Professional Ethics in Mathematics
description: Identify ethical issues in mathematical modeling, data handling, statistics, algorithmic decisions, and AI, ChatGPT, internet etc, analyse real-world ethical dilemmas using mathematical reasoning. Apply ethical frameworks to research publishing, proof validation, and plagiarism. Demonstrate responsible conduct in teaching, assessment, and supervision.
